verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Grafana sandbox or test environment that isolates agent or user testing from production data. What it does show is adjacent: a CLI that can "manage multiple environments" (the user still has to provision a separate non-prod instance), running Loki locally, automated testing of as-code configs, and tenant isolation in GEL. None of these is a product-provided sandbox for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
